scope: Eight sequential 1M real-FDB samples (four per tree), plus existing planner-only shape benchmarks (three 200-iteration observations per shape per tree). Not a claim of universal performance equivalence.
interpretation: Initial GROUP/SUM wall-clock increases did not persist in samples 3-4 of either tree; all 11 logged EXPLAIN lines match and planner benchmark medians remain close. All samples are retained, including the slow first/second identical million-row scan occurrences. No broad speedup or zero-regression claim is inferred from these noisy samples.
